# `assembly.attach`

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs-gen` from crates/ew-commands/schemas/assembly.attach.schema.json. Do not edit: change the source and regenerate. -->

`assembly.attach` (`AttachChildren`): makes existing devices children of a parent device (doc 03 §7:
modules of a valve terminal under its head device, a mounting plate under its enclosure), with their
positions (FR-DEV-022: child order is `Device.position`, never the drawing).

Sets `Device.parent = parent` and `Device.position` of every child (a child given without a position
keeps none). At least one child; children distinct and different from the parent; all exist
(`CmdError::NotFound`). Rejected: a position 0 (positions are 1-based, at `/children/i/position`); two
children of the command at one position; a position another child of the parent already holds (no
push insert in v0: move that child first); a child that is the parent's ancestor (the assembly graph is
acyclic, EW-INV-009). A child that has another parent moves to this one. A child tag (`tag.scheme =
child`, not frozen) whose counter equals its old position follows the new position (N-FL-2, doc 11
§4.2); any other tag is not touched. A child tag is set with `fields.set`, a valve added with `valve.add`.
The generated assembly overviews, slots, break marks and the PLC overview follow from the tree (they are
derived). Outcome: the parent.

## Types

### ChildSpec

One child of `AttachChildren`.

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `device` | [`CmdUuid`](#cmduuid) | yes |  | The child device. |
| `position` | integer (format `uint32`, min 0) or `null` | no |  | Its position inside the parent (manifold order, 1-based); absent: no position (an unordered child such as a mounting plate). |

### CmdUuid

A lower-case hyphenated UUID naming a record (doc 05 §3.2).

Type: string (at least 36 character(s), at most 36 character(s))

Pattern: `^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$`

## Exit codes

A command runs as one line of a command log replayed by `ew apply` ([doc 17 §3.5](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/docs/design/17-extensibility.md#35-command-logs-ewcmd)). The exit code of `ew apply` is:

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | The line committed as one transaction. |
| 1 | A prevent rule or the command's own domain rule refused the line (`Prevented`, `Rejected`); without `--one-step` the lines before it stay committed and are saved, with `--one-step` nothing is saved. |
| 2 | Anything else stops the replay: invalid parameters, a missing record, an unresolvable reference, an open, lock or save error. |

The codes of every subcommand are in [doc 17 §3.2](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/docs/design/17-extensibility.md#32-exit-codes).
